Found **two issues to fix before merging**:

1. **Incorrect extension parsing** — `src/extension.js:2` uses the second dot-separated segment instead of the last, and doesn’t lowercase it. Verified: `photo.jpg.png` returns `image/jpeg` instead of `image/png`; `photo.JPG` and `Archive.TAR.GZ` fall back to `application/octet-stream`. Dotless names also return `undefined` rather than the documented empty string.
   **Recommended fix:** Extract the text after the last dot, lowercase it, and return `''` when there’s no extension.

2. **Inherited properties bypass the MIME fallback** — `src/content-type.js:11` looks up extensions on a normal object without checking ownership. Verified: `file.constructor` returns a function and `file.__proto__` returns an object, rather than `application/octet-stream`.
   **Recommended fix:** Use an own-property check, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`.

All **3 existing tests pass**, but `test/extension.test.js` covers only `photo.jpg`, and there are no content-type tests covering these failures.

Reviewed `upload-extensions` at `a34d0a4` against `main`. **No files changed.**
